    OR = {
            has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier
            has_country_modifier = zhx_fa_invited_scholar_modifier

            has_country_modifier = zhx_bing_invited_scholar_modifier
            has_country_modifier = zhx_zongheng_invited_scholar_modifier
        }
}

zhx_guest_school_has_active_contract = {
    has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_active
    OR = {
            has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru
            has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_fa
            has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_mo

            has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_bing
            has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_zongheng
        }
}

zhx_guest_school_may_invite = {
    zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
    zhx_has_doctrine = yes
    has_religious_school = yes
    NOT = { zhx_doctrine_reform_invitation_locked = yes }
    NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_active }
    NOT = { zhx_guest_school_has_active_contract = yes }
    NOT = {
        OR = {
                has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru
                has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_fa
                has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_mo
                has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_dao
                has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_bing
                has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_zongheng
            }
    }
    NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_guest_school_dishonour }
    NOT = { zhx_guest_school_has_any_invited_benefit = yes }
    dip_power = 75
    years_of_income = 0.5
}

    zhx_guest_school_may_invite = yes
    NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru }
    has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_ru

zhx_guest_school_ai_may_renew = {
    ai = yes
    is_at_war = no
    stability = 0
    NOT = { num_of_loans = 1 }
    dip_power = 125
    years_of_income = 0.5
    zhx_guest_school_has_valid_renewal_source = yes
    OR = {
        AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru zhx_guest_school_ai_wants_renew_ru = yes }
        AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_fa zhx_guest_school_ai_wants_renew_fa = yes }
        AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_mo zhx_guest_school_ai_wants_renew_mo = yes }
        AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_dao zhx_guest_school_ai_wants_renew_dao = yes }
        AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_bing zhx_guest_school_ai_wants_renew_bing = yes }
        AND = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_zongheng zhx_guest_school_ai_wants_renew_zongheng = yes }
    }
